config_root.description: Custom XDG config directory (overrides XDG_CONFIG_HOME/direnv). Empty string uses default.

allow_file.description: Path to the allow list file (records direnv-allowed .envrc paths). Empty string uses default ($XDG_DATA_HOME/direnv/allow).

shell_integration_enabled.description: List of shells for which direnv hook is enabled (e.g., bash, zsh, fish, tcsh, elvish). Must be valid shell names supported by direnv hook.

fish_mode.description: Fish shell trigger mode. One of: eval_on_arrow (default), eval_after_arrow, disable_arrow.

stdlib_path.description: Additional stdlib search paths. Overrides or extends built-in direnv-stdlib.

extra_lib_paths.description: Extra library paths (e.g., $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/direnv/lib/*.sh) loaded before each .envrc.

log_level.description: Log verbosity. One of: debug, info, warn, error. Empty string uses default (usually info).
